title: Observational Study of Elizaria® in aHUS Patients
brief_summary: It is a multicenter observational non-comparative study of the efficacy and safety of long-term pathogenetic Elizaria® therapy in patients with atypical Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

1. Written informed consent to study participation.
2. Male and female patients aged 2 months and older with documented atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS)diagnosis.
3. By the time of inclusion in the study, Elizaria® should be prescribed as a pathogenetic therapy for aHUS; Exclusion Criteria

1\. Intolerance to eculizumab, or other components of the drug.
study_population: At least 50 adult and pediatric patients (from 2 months), with a confirmed diagnosis of aHUS, who meet the enrollment criteria.
